messages.text: The backend foundation is in place, including checkout as a transaction and all requested metrics as SQL aggregates. I’m reserving the source’s varied media geometry now and creating a cohesive set of local, high-resolution editorial images for those crops; this avoids both fragile remote image URLs and the equal-height placeholder-card failure the brief explicitly rules out.
